prompts.name: daily-check-in
prompts.prompt: Create ONE achievement medal asset for fituus, a gentle wellness app. Reference mood: a shiny embossed collectible coin like a cute enamel medal, but simplified, premium and softly pastel. ONLY the round medal itself, no packaging, no card, no ribbon, no text, no numbers, no stars floating outside. Front-facing perfectly circular thick coin with a smooth raised double rim, delicate metallic bevel, softly frosted enamel inner disk, clean raised relief emblem at center. Subtle diagonal pearlescent highlight from upper left to lower right, soft studio lighting, restrained gloss, no harsh glare hiding the emblem. Rounded friendly shapes, legible at 80px, no microdetail. Square composition: medal centered at 78% canvas width with equal padding all sides. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no colored square. Cohesive collectible achievement series. Emblem: a cheerful simple embossed sun with eight short rounded rays and a small curved smile, no complex face. Palette warm peach #E3AA88 with pale champagne #F2F2F2 highlights and warm copper-peach edges. Represents daily check-in and showing up. The sun and rim should be warm peach-gold tonal relief, no blue or pink.
